patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.. Choose Insightly only if your buying job matches “CRM plus project management for service-oriented SMBs, with automation and AI on higher pl” rather than Salesforce's shape. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than Insightly's shape. Workflow advantage: Insightly leans contact-management; Salesforce leans sales-automation, complex-sales-processes. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Insightly is CRM plus project management for service-oriented SMBs, with automation and AI on higher plans.; Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams..
- Company-size focus: Insightly (small-business, mid-market) vs Salesforce (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Insightly-leaning contact-management vs Salesforce-leaning sales-automation, complex-sales-processes, outbound-sales.
- Researched limits: Insightly — Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions.; Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO..

Limitations — Insightly: Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions.; Confirm live Insightly checkout; packaging can change.; Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us..

Poor-fit cases: Insightly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions. · Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · Avoid Insightly if you actually need Salesforce's motion (Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
